svg.title: Zyro Centerline Master (canonical v2.5)
svg.desc: Centerline master for the frozen v2.5 glyph: one black infinity field plus one continuous white Orbit centerline. Outline = field fill + Orbit stroked at the white-channel width.
svg.metadata: { "name": "Zyro Centerline Master", "version": "2.5-canonical", "frozen": "2026-06-10", "model": "black-field + single white Orbit centerline (NOT the 10:25:10 ribbon)", "supersedes": "zyro_master.svg (v3 ribbon, 10:25:10) — kept as historical", "units": "viewBox units", "viewBox": [0, 0, 200, 100], "glyphBounds": { "x": 5, "y": 7, "width": 190, "height": 86 }, "topology": { "trajectoryCount": 1, "centerlineType": "open", "selfCrossings": 1, "start": "left-spiral-eye", "end": "lower-left-interior", "crossing": "single convergence node" }, "channelSystem": { "model": "single white channel carved by the Orbit centerline", "whiteChannelWidth": 9, "blackField": "independent fill (left lobe + right Void chamber)", "innerBlackBorder": "none (white Orbit sits directly on the black field)" }, "orbit": { "leftSpiralCenter": [43, 50], "turns": 1.1, "direction": "eye-outward-to-convergence" }, "convergence": { "x": 100, "y": 50, "type": "single self-crossing" }, "void": { "center": [150, 50], "referenceRadiusX": 40, "referenceRadiusY": 33, "fill": "#000000" }, "scaling": { "to1000UPM": "x5 (master 1000 x 500)" }, "export": { "masterGeometry": "live centerline offset (Orbit stroked at 9) over black field", "manufacturingStep": "stroke-to-path the Orbit (9), union at crossing, subtract from black field -> one compound path, Orbit as counters", "editPolicy": "edit only zyro-orbit-centerline and zyro-black-field" } }
